claim_verdicts.suggested_text: its `--no-cache` option stops `apk` keeping its own downloaded files (such as its package list) in the image, and has nothing to do with Docker's layer cache. / Docker shows a `RUN` step as `/bin/sh -c` followed by the command (base-image rows may add build settings before it), because it runs the command through the image's shell.
